system.description:
You have been taught some of the old lore, of special blends of herbs, plant oils, and other chemicals that heighten reflexes, make a warrior fearless, and numb them to pain. Such a blend would be poisonous to outsiders, but you have built up a resistance.

You may spend 1 Supply Point at the start of a conflict scene to administer the Spear’s Blend — this might be inhaled, drank, rubbed on the gums, or administered another way. During the scene, you gain one extra Spirit whenever you use the Adrenaline Rush option to regain Spirit by adding to Threat.
